source_dataset_notes: Type: Simulated. Table 1, numerical values only. Mean metrics across 150 synthetic IE datasets, including paired-end read lengths 50, 75 and 100 bp (50 datasets per length). Source TPR is recall. The source calls FP/all detected fusions FPR, i.e. false discovery proportion, so precision=1-FPR. F1 is reconstructed from rounded mean precision and recall, NOT mean replicate F1 or pooled-count F1. TrueFusionNumber=50 per individual simulated dataset, not the aggregate denominator. These simulation instances are not independent biological cohorts. Extraction covers Table 1 IE aggregate only; BE and read-length-specific supplementary tables S6-S12 were not extracted. Version numbers were not verified. Source: https://academic.oup.com/bioinformatics/article/28/24/3232/247436

dataset_name: Nicorici 2014: Edgren (40-reference, four cell lines aggregated)
overlap_scope: Shared Edgren sequencing source; sample subsets, aggregation, reference catalog and scoring can differ.
truthset_reference: 40 RT-PCR-validated Edgren/Kangaspeska fusions; incomplete real-data reference
source_dataset_notes: Type: Real, cell line. Paired-end 50 bp. Preprint, bioRxiv v1, 19 November 2014. Numerical Table 1. Four breast cancer cell lines: BT-474, SK-BR-3, KPL-4 and MCF-7. Reference: 40 RT-PCR-validated fusions (27 from Edgren 2011 plus 13 from Kangaspeska 2012). Biological dataset identity: Edgren. Shared sequencing source with other Edgren benchmarks; different truthset sizes must remain distinguishable. Aggregate scores, not four separate sample scores. Precision=validated matches/all reported calls; recall=validated matches/40; reconstructed reference-based F1=2*validated matches/(reported calls+40). Calls unmatched to this incomplete real-data reference have unknown biological status, not confirmed biological FP. Published rounded precision is not used for calculation. Table 2 spike-in results are not extracted because it reports detection counts without total prediction counts for precision/F1. Source: https://doi.org/10.1101/011650
